subject: Initial planning: demo window matrix & procurement handoff
messages:
From: Oliver Núñez <oliver.nunez@acmecorp.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: sara.kim@acmecorp.com, john.doe@acmecorp.com
Date: 2026-10-18T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro/demo request — aligning stakeholders and windows

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick connector earlier. We have three stakeholder groups that need to be on the demo: Customer Engineering (me), Procurement (Sara), and IT Security (John). We also have teammates across PST (mostly San Francisco), CET (Berlin), and SGT (Singapore) so finding an overlap is tricky.

Target next steps: a 60-minute product + integration demo for the engineering team, and a separate 30-minute procurement/contracting sync for our procurement team. Procurement needs SOC2 evidence and a high-level pricing run-rate to proceed.

Availability window this week: Oct 22–26. Preferred times: 8:30–11:00 PT or 16:00–19:00 CET. APAC folks can only do late evenings (20:00–22:00 CET / 03:00–05:00 SGT) so if we want to include them, rotating times or recording is fine.

Can you propose a concrete schedule (matrix with rotating times) and loop in your SE so we can check integration scenarios? Also please send any procurement artifacts upfront (SOC2 summary, MSA pointers).

Thanks,
Oliver
Customer Engineering — Acme Corp

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Núñez <oliver.nunez@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, sara.kim@acmecorp.com, john.doe@acmecorp.com
Date: 2026-10-18T18:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro/demo request — aligning stakeholders and windows

Hi Oliver — thanks, this is helpful.

Short plan:
- I’ll own scheduling and procurement touchpoints (AE).
- Marcus (SE) will run the engineering demo and validate integration flow.
- Rishi (sales manager) will be on standby for any contract/SLA exceptions.

Proposal: Instead of one one-off slot, we often use a rotating-week matrix that covers each timezone reasonably while keeping a single weekly cadence for the customer (reduces scheduling churn). Example (first pass):
- Week A (US-friendly): Tues 09:30–10:30 PT / 18:30–19:30 CET
- Week B (EU-friendly): Wed 11:00–12:00 PT / 20:00–21:00 CET (better for APAC observers)
- Week C (APAC-friendly): Thu 16:00–17:00 PT / Fri 01:00–02:00 SGT (SE-led deep-dive for APAC only)

That lets you keep a weekly recurring slot while rotating which timezone gets the convenient local time. We can also hold a separate 30-min procurement-only cadence aligned to Week A or on-demand.

Attached: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (60min engineering + 20min Q/A + next-steps checklist).

Can you confirm: the preferred start week (we have open slots starting Nov 1), and whether Acme prefers rotating weekly invites or fixed one-offs per region? If you want, I can publish a calendar poll for your team.

Thanks — looping Marcus to propose technical cadence.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@acmecorp.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: john.doe@acmecorp.com, Oliver Núñez <oliver.nunez@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T08:44:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Intro/demo request — aligning stakeholders and windows

Hi Kimberly,

Procurement notes: we need a SOC2 summary (in-scope controls and last audit date), sample MSA terms (termination/LI), and a short pricing estimate to start internal approval. We usually fill out a short mutual action plan (MAP) and require a PO template for procurement.

Ideal timeline from Acme procurement perspective: internal approval within 3 weeks, so the vendor kickoff/PO needs to be in our tracker by Nov 10. If you can share a MAP and SOC2 summary today, that helps reduce review cycles.

Also prefer a fixed weekly procurement sync — 30 minutes Week A (US-friendly) is best for our finance lead.

Attaching: SOC2-summary-request.pdf (example of the level of detail we need).

Thanks,
Sara 
Procurement — Acme Corp
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Núñez <oliver.nunez@acmecorp.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, sara.kim@acmecorp.com, john.doe@acmecorp.com
Date: 2026-10-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro/demo request — aligning stakeholders and windows

Oliver / team — Marcus here (SE). Quick technical notes and a concrete rotation matrix attached (demo-rotation-matrix.xlsx).

A few points:
- For the engineering demo we’ll focus on: latency/throughput profiles, deployment options (hosted vs private), and the integration checklist for KV cache and prefix caching. Please share any sample payload shapes or downstream connectors you’d like covered.
- For APAC deep dives we usually run a separate 30–45 minute session that drills into private deployment networking and KMS flows (because of time for legal/security folks).
- Proposed practical cadence: two recurring invites — 60min weekly rotating demo (engineering) + 30min weekly procurement sync (fixed Week A). On weeks when the demo is APAC-friendly we record and share notes for the US team.

Matrix summary included. Also attached a compact CSV inside the workbook with suggested calendar start dates (Nov 2 start, rotation repeats every 3 weeks).

On logistics: if Acme needs an SLA exception or committed throughput block while evaluating, loop Rishi who can expedite an internal approval.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: John Doe <john.doe@acmecorp.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Oliver Núñez <oliver.nunez@acmecorp.com>, sara.kim@acmecorp.com
Date: 2026-10-20T14:36:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Intro/demo request — aligning stakeholders and windows

Kimberly / Marcus — thanks. We like the rotating approach if it reduces calendar churn. A couple of asks from security:
1) Please provide the last SOC2 type II date and the artifact owner contact.
2) A short note on data residency options for EU customers (is Private deployment available in our Frankfurt GTM?).

Availability: We can commit to the rotation starting the week of Nov 1. For calendar convenience, propose the rotation pattern you suggested but with a fixed procurement sync on Tuesday 09:30 PT (Week A). That lines up with our procurement window.

I’ve attached our PO template (acme-po-template.docx). Once we have the MAP and SOC2 summary we’ll route the PO.

Regards,
John Doe
IT Security — Acme Corp

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: oliver.nunez@acmecorp.com, sara.kim@acmecorp.com, john.doe@acmecorp.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com, rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-21T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro/demo request — aligning stakeholders and windows

Perfect — thank you all for the quick responses. Finalizing plan below and I’ll send calendar invites once you confirm the start week (Nov 1):

Finalized plan (agreed items):
- Kickoff cadence: Weekly 60-minute rotating demo (engineering) starting week of Nov 1. Rotation repeats every 3 weeks (Week A = US-friendly; Week B = EU-friendly; Week C = APAC-friendly).
- Procurement: 30-minute fixed sync on Week A (Tue 09:30 PT) — procurement will get a separate recurring invite.
- Security artifacts: attaching SOC2 summary and MAP now. Marcus will run a dedicated APAC security deep-dive on demand.
- Logistics: I’ve attached a draft mutual action plan (mutual-action-plan.xlsx) and will upload the deal to HubSpot (link below). Once you sign the PO template we’ll follow DocuSign.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx, SOC2-summary-request.pdf (copy).

Calendar approach: I’ll create two recurring calendar invites: 1) "Acme — Weekly Rotating Demo (60m)" with a rule in the description explaining the Week A/B/C rotation and a link to the rotation matrix; 2) "Acme — Procurement Sync (30m)" recurring weekly Tue 09:30 PT. If you prefer, I can instead send three timezone-specific one-offs.

Please reply with a one-line confirmation on the start week (Nov 1) and I’ll publish the invites.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0132
